parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: ProxyId
parameters.description: The ID of the NAT firewall.

parameters.name: ProxyName
parameters.description: The name of the NAT firewall. The name can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length and cannot start with an underscore.

parameters.name: StrictMode
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable strict mode. Valid values:

- 1: strict mode.
- 0: loose mode.
